name: Huion drawing tablets and pen displays
summary: Huion pen tablets and pen displays. Without a driver the pen moves the pointer like a mouse, but pressure and the shortcut buttons do nothing.

linux.notes: Many Huion tablets work with Linux's built-in uclogic driver. For full pressure and button support on any Linux distribution, OpenTabletDriver (free, open source) supports most Huion models.

darwin.notes: Install Huion's driver, or the free and open-source OpenTabletDriver, then allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security under Accessibility. No security changes are needed.

steps.title: Download the Huion driver
steps.explain: Download the driver for your tablet model and install it. OpenTabletDriver (opentabletdriver.net) is a free alternative.

steps.title: Allow the driver and replug the tablet
steps.explain: When macOS asks, allow the driver in System Settings > Privacy & Security. Then unplug the tablet, plug it back in and press "Check again".

win32.notes: Install Huion's driver, or the free and open-source OpenTabletDriver.

steps.title: Download the Huion driver
steps.explain: Download the driver for your tablet model and install it. OpenTabletDriver (opentabletdriver.net) is a free alternative.

steps.title: Replug the tablet
steps.explain: Unplug the tablet, plug it back in and press "Check again".
